Breadcrumb Generator

Build an accessible breadcrumb trail from your path segments — live preview plus HTML and CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter path segments (one per line, or a full /path).
  2. Pick a separator and visual style.
  3. Preview the breadcrumb live.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained breadcrumb.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What segment format do I use?

One per line ("Home", "Products", "Shoes") — or paste a full path like /products/shoes and it is split automatically.

Is it SEO friendly?

Yes — it uses <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with an ordered list, and the current page gets aria-current="page".

Can I use a custom separator?

Choose the custom option and type any character or symbol.

Can I embed it in my page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with bc- to avoid collisions.
